title: Docs: add internal demo environment page stub (access-gated) + enablement links
author: Elliot Price
description: Goal: create an internal-facing docs landing page for the Standard Demo v1 “demo environment” (demo tenant) that acts as a single entry point for AEs/SEs, while keeping it access-gated and explicitly non-public. This PR adds a stub page behind our internal access gate and links out to the canonical enablement materials (deck, talk track, security FAQ, runbook/reset checklist). The page intentionally avoids embedding credential details or customer-sensitive information; it includes pointers to where access is requested and where the operational runbook lives. Scope: docs-site stub + nav entry + link hygiene; no changes to demo tenant configs, scripts, or public docs. Notes: this is a first pass intended to reduce “where do I find the latest stuff?” churn while PMM/SE finalizes the deck/talk track. Follow-ups: add a lightweight “known-good scenarios matrix” section once the sheet stabilizes; add ownership + escalation path once SRE confirms the demo-oncall policy; add EU-residency caveat language for EMEA demos after review by Sales leadership.
commits: docs(demo): add internal demo environment landing page
docs(nav): add internal-only entry under Sales Enablement
docs(security): add explicit guidance on not pasting customer data + retention pointers
chore(links): normalize enablement links + add redirect stubs
conversation: Elliot Price (author): Added a minimal internal page stub and wired it into the internal nav. The content is intentionally light and mostly links out to enablement assets; no credentials, no tenant IDs, no screenshots that might drift. Would love review on (1) language/positioning for PMM, (2) security posture wording, (3) whether the link destinations are the right “source of truth” for field teams.

Soojin Lee (review): Copy looks mostly aligned. Two tweaks: please change “production-grade demo tenant” to “sales demo environment” (we don’t want prospects to confuse this with their own production). Also add a short section that says which personas the page is intended for (platform/ML/security) and where to find persona branches (talk track doc).
Elliot Price (author): Updated phrasing to “sales demo environment” and added a short “Who this is for” section with pointers to the talk track branches. Pushed in commit 3c1a8f1.

Naomi Feldman (review): Please add an explicit warning callout: do not paste customer prompts containing sensitive data into the demo tenant; no guarantees re: PHI/PCI. Also: on the retention sentence, avoid stating numbers unless we’re certain—use “see Security FAQ for current retention defaults and customer-configurable options.”
Elliot Price (author): Added an InternalOnly callout at top + revised retention wording to defer to the Security FAQ. Also removed an implied “30 day” statement. Pushed in commit 91d2b0d.

Markus Klein (review): Links: Can we point to the Confluence runbook as primary, but also include the Drive reset checklist? Field teams keep searching Drive. Also suggest adding a small “Day-of-demo checklist” bullet list (verify dashboards green, quotas reset, model pinned) that mirrors the reset checklist without duplicating it fully.

Elliot Price (author): Done: runbook link first, reset checklist link second. Added a short “Before you join the call” list that explicitly says “follow the checklist” rather than duplicating. Pushed in commit b6a44c2.
Renee Sullivan (review): Minor: please include the quickstart template link (curl + SDK examples) since AEs ask for it post-demo. Otherwise looks good.
Elliot Price (author): Added a “After the demo” section with the quickstart link and suggested follow-up assets. Pushed in commit 2fe0c6a.
Soojin Lee (review): Approved after latest edits. Thanks for keeping this internal-only and not baking in volatile screenshots.
Naomi Feldman (review): Approved. Callout is clear; appreciate deferring specifics to the Security FAQ.
Markus Klein (review): Approved. This should reduce Slack pings significantly.
release_notes: Internal docs only: added an access-gated “Demo environment” landing page that links to Standard Demo v1 enablement assets (deck, talk track, security FAQ, runbook/reset checklist, quickstart).
